questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The politician made an _____ speech about education reform.'
explanation: Eloquent means well-spoken and persuasive - E-L-O-Q-U-E-N-T. An eloquent speech is one that is fluent and forceful.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The ancient ruins were an _____ reminder of a great civilization.'
explanation: Evocative means bringing strong feelings or memories to mind - E-V-O-C-A-T-I-V-E.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'Her _____ approach to problem-solving impressed her supervisors.'
explanation: Pragmatic means dealing with things practically - P-R-A-G-M-A-T-I-C. A pragmatic approach focuses on practical solutions.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'The judge remained _____ throughout the hearing.'
explanation: Impartial means not favoring one side - I-M-P-A-R-T-I-A-L. A judge must be impartial to be fair.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The scientist made a _____ discovery that changed medicine.'
explanation: Groundbreaking means innovative and pioneering - G-R-O-U-N-D-B-R-E-A-K-I-N-G. It describes something entirely new.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'Her _____ personality helped her make friends easily.'
explanation: Affable means friendly and easy to talk to - A-F-F-A-B-L-E. An affable person is warm and approachable.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The _____ evidence convinced the jury of his guilt.'
explanation: Irrefutable means impossible to deny - I-R-R-E-F-U-T-A-B-L-E. Irrefutable evidence cannot be disputed.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'The old photograph _____ memories of her childhood.'
explanation: Evoked means brought to mind - E-V-O-K-E-D. A photograph evokes memories by triggering emotions.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The new law was _____ because it had too many loopholes.'
explanation: Ineffective means not producing the desired result - I-N-E-F-F-E-C-T-I-V-E. In- is the correct negative prefix.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The two nations signed a _____ trade agreement.'
explanation: Bilateral means involving two parties - B-I-L-A-T-E-R-A-L. Bi- means two, lateral means side.

questionText: Choose the word that best fits: 'The artist had a _____ gift for capturing emotions in paint.'
explanation: Remarkable means worthy of attention - R-E-M-A-R-K-A-B-L-E. A remarkable gift stands out from the ordinary.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'Her _____ nature made her avoid large social gatherings.'
explanation: Introverted means shy or reserved - I-N-T-R-O-V-E-R-T-E-D. An introverted person prefers being alone.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The medicine had a _____ effect, curing both conditions.'
explanation: Dual means having two parts or aspects - D-U-A-L. A dual effect works in two ways simultaneously.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'The speaker used _____ language to explain a complex topic simply.'
explanation: Accessible means easy to understand - A-C-C-E-S-S-I-B-L-E. Accessible language is clear and simple.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The document must be signed by an _____ authority.'
explanation: Authorized means having official permission - A-U-T-H-O-R-I-Z-E-D. An authorized authority has legal approval.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The team showed great _____ by completing the project ahead of schedule.'
explanation: Diligence means careful and persistent effort - D-I-L-I-G-E-N-C-E. It describes hard work done with attention.

questionText: Choose the word that best completes: 'Her writing style is _____, using many flowery expressions.'
explanation: Florid means elaborately decorative - F-L-O-R-I-D. Florid writing is overly embellished with ornate language.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The director made a _____ decision to shut down the project.'
explanation: Unilateral means done by one person or side - U-N-I-L-A-T-E-R-A-L. Uni- means one.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The old building had a _____ quality that reminded visitors of the past.'
explanation: Nostalgic means evoking a sentimental longing for the past - N-O-S-T-A-L-G-I-C.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'The scientist was known for her _____ research methods.'
explanation: Meticulous means very careful and precise - M-E-T-I-C-U-L-O-U-S. Meticulous research leaves no details unchecked.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'His speech was full of _____, making it difficult to understand.'
explanation: Jargon is specialized language used by a particular group - J-A-R-G-O-N. It is often confusing to outsiders.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The teacher was known for her _____ explanations that made difficult topics easy.'
explanation: Lucid means clear and easy to understand - L-U-C-I-D. A lucid explanation is transparent and straightforward.

questionText: Choose the word that best fits: 'The athlete showed great _____ by continuing despite the injury.'
explanation: Tenacity means persistence and determination - T-E-N-A-C-I-T-Y. It refers to not giving up even in adversity.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The company made a _____ announcement about its merger plans.'
explanation: Preliminary means preceding or done in preparation - P-R-E-L-I-M-I-N-A-R-Y. A preliminary announcement is an initial one.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The new policy aims to _____ inequality in education.'
explanation: Eliminate means to completely remove - E-L-I-M-I-N-A-T-E. The policy aims to get rid of educational inequality.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'The professor spoke in a _____ tone that held everyone's attention.'
explanation: Authoritative means commanding and confident - A-U-T-H-O-R-I-T-A-T-I-V-E. It inspires confidence and respect.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'Her _____ approach meant she considered all possible outcomes.'
explanation: Comprehensive means complete and including everything - C-O-M-P-R-E-H-E-N-S-I-V-E.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The team was able to _____ the problem through collaboration.'
explanation: Resolve means to find a solution - R-E-S-O-L-V-E. Collaboration helped the team resolve the problem.

questionText: Choose the word that best fits: 'The diplomat used _____ language to avoid causing offence.'
explanation: Diplomatic means tactful and skilled in handling sensitive situations - D-I-P-L-O-M-A-T-I-C.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The news report was _____, presenting facts without bias.'
explanation: Objective means not influenced by personal feelings - O-B-J-E-C-T-I-V-E. Objective reporting presents facts fairly.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The discovery had _____ implications for the field of medicine.'
explanation: Profound means very significant and far-reaching - P-R-O-F-O-U-N-D. A profound discovery changes things deeply.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'Her _____ behaviour made everyone uncomfortable at the formal dinner.'
explanation: Inappropriate means not suitable for the situation - I-N-A-P-P-R-O-P-R-I-A-T-E.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The company faces a _____ challenge in the competitive market.'
explanation: Formidable means inspiring fear or respect through being impressively large - F-O-R-M-I-D-A-B-L-E.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The poem had a _____ quality that lingered in the reader's mind.'
explanation: Haunting means poignant and evocative - H-A-U-N-T-I-N-G. A haunting quality stays with you long after.

questionText: Choose the word that best fits: 'Her _____ memory allowed her to recall details from years ago.'
explanation: Phenomenal means remarkably exceptional - P-H-E-N-O-M-E-N-A-L. A phenomenal memory is extraordinarily good.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The teacher gave a _____ account of historical events.'
explanation: Chronological means arranged in order of time - C-H-R-O-N-O-L-O-G-I-C-A-L. Chrono- means time.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The artist was known for her _____ use of color in her paintings.'
explanation: Vibrant means full of energy and color - V-I-B-R-A-N-T. Vibrant colors are bright and striking.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'The orphan led a _____ life, moving from home to home.'
explanation: Nomadic means moving from place to place without a fixed home - N-O-M-A-D-I-C.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The scientist had an _____ curiosity that drove her to explore new ideas.'
explanation: Insatiable means impossible to satisfy - I-N-S-A-T-I-A-B-L-E. An insatiable curiosity always wants to know more.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'He was known for his _____ sense of humour that could disarm any tense situation.'
explanation: Disarming means making someone feel less defensive - D-I-S-A-R-M-I-N-G. A disarming personality puts people at ease.

questionText: Choose the word that best fits: 'The CEO made a _____ decision to restructure the company.'
explanation: Bold means showing willingness to take risks - B-O-L-D. A bold decision is courageous and decisive.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The review praised the film for its _____ narrative structure.'
explanation: Innovative means featuring new methods or ideas - I-N-N-O-V-A-T-I-V-E. An innovative structure breaks new ground.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The students were _____ to learn that the exam had been postponed.'
explanation: Relieved means no longer feeling anxious - R-E-L-I-E-V-E-D. The students felt relief when the exam was postponed.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'The company published a _____ report detailing its environmental impact.'
explanation: Comprehensive means covering everything - C-O-M-P-R-E-H-E-N-S-I-V-E. A comprehensive report is thorough and complete.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The author wrote with great _____, making every word count.'
explanation: Precision means the quality of being exact - P-R-E-C-I-S-I-O-N. Writing with precision uses words carefully and accurately.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The government took _____ measures to control the spread of disease.'
explanation: Preventive means designed to stop something from happening - P-R-E-V-E-N-T-I-V-E. Preventive measures stop a problem before it occurs.

questionText: Choose the word that best fits: 'His _____ attitude toward work made him unpopular with colleagues.'
explanation: Complacent means self-satisfied and unaware of danger - C-O-M-P-L-A-C-E-N-T. Complacency leads to overlooking problems.

questionText: Select the correct word: 'The speaker made an _____ argument for environmental protection.'
explanation: Impassioned means filled with great emotion - I-M-P-A-S-S-I-O-N-E-D. An impassioned argument is deeply felt.

questionText: Choose the correct word: 'The project required _____ planning to ensure success.'
explanation: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail - M-E-T-I-C-U-L-O-U-S. Meticulous planning covers every detail.

questionText: Select the word that best fits: 'The judge remained _____ throughout the lengthy trial.'
explanation: Stoic means enduring pain without showing emotions - S-T-O-I-C. A stoic judge shows no emotional reaction.
